title: deploy auth-phasing and slim stream UX for py/ts/go
author: Claire Nguyen
release_notes: Introduces credential phasing to reduce stream reconnect churn; new compact retry profiles and minor ergonomic stream API surface changes across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Backwards compatible; minor SDK version bumps (py 1.13.0 -> 1.14.0, ts 2.9.1 -> 2.10.0, go v0.9.7 -> v0.10.0).
description: Summary: This PR implements an "auth phasing" pattern and a slimmed stream ergonomics surface across the three SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go). The goal is to reduce 'stream fidget'—reconnects and token races observed when credentials rotate out-of-band—and to offer a consistent, lightweight API for long-lived pull/push streams that is parity-friendly across languages. Motivation: Multiple production customers reported intermittent reconnect noise during credential rotation windows and inconsistent stream ergonomics across SDKs. Root-cause analysis (ENG-2150) showed a pattern: SDKs attempted immediate token swap mid-chunk which caused in-flight iterator cancellations and duplicate reconnections. This surfaced as increased p99 latencies and amplified token refresh storms under load. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a credential phasing mechanism (phase window + soft-swap): SDKs now enter a configurable 'grace phase' before switching to a newly fetched token. During grace, outgoing calls accept existing token while background refresh obtains primary replacement; only once phase completes do in-flight streams observe the new token. 2) Adds compact retry profiles: small, medium, and conservative presets tuned for streaming workloads, preserving latency SLOs while increasing robustness. 3) Stream surface polish: introduces a lightweight StreamHandle abstraction (py: StreamHandle, ts: StreamHandle, go: StreamHandle) that exposes pause(), resume(), and a small set of deterministic state transitions to avoid caller-level race conditions. 4) Cross-language parity shim: common spec document and test harness updated to define precise semantics for credential handoff and stream pause/resume semantics; SDK implementations adapted to match spec. 5) Version bumps in each SDK and updated changelogs/examples. High-level commits: - feat: credential phasing core logic and phasing config (py/ts/go) - feat: compact retry presets + telemetry hooks - feat: StreamHandle API and implementation for each SDK - test: cross-sdk contract tests for phasing and stream transitions - docs: spec and examples + migration notes - ci: matrix updates to run cross-sdk contract tests on PRs Review/revisions: Initial review requested by Diego Morales on 2026-01-20. Key comments: - Diego: "Please clarify how phasing interacts with cached KV entries for the runtime; ensure we don't leak stale auth into cache keys." Response: Implemented an explicit cache key invalidation hook in the py/ts/go runtime adapters; added unit tests. - Aisha: "TS surface looks ok but ergonomic names clash with existing helpers (pause vs suspend)." Response: Chose pause()/resume() to stay language-agnostic; added aliases to maintain backwards compat for TS helper suspend() -> pause(). - Ethan: "Can we avoid an additional API dependency in Go?" Response: Kept StreamHandle zero-dep by embedding into existing connection struct; added doc explaining no new external deps. CI and stability: Cross-sdk contract tests were added to the Github Actions matrix. The first CI run showed flaky test in TypeScript contract harness; fixed by adding deterministic seed and a 50ms jitter to token-refresh mock. Final CI status: all checks passed including unit, linters, cross-sdk-contract, and integration smoke tests. Files changed (selected highlights): - python/redwood_sdk/stream/stream_handle.py (new): implements StreamHandle and phasing state machine - python/redwood_sdk/auth/phasing.py (modified): core phasing logic and configs - python/tests/test_phasing_contract.py (new): contract tests for phasing - typescript/src/stream/stream_handle.ts (new): TS implementation + adapters - typescript/src/auth/phasing.ts (modified) - typescript/test/contract/phasing.spec.ts (new) - go/sdk/stream/stream_handle.go (new) - go/sdk/auth/phasing.go (modified) - docs/sdk-auth-phasing-spec.md (new): cross-language spec and examples - examples/streaming/credential-phasing-demo (updated) Migration notes for integrators: - Default behavior is off (phasing.enabled=false). Enable selectively in environments where token rotation storms observed. - Suggested presets: compact (low-latency), medium (balanced), conservative (max-robustness) mapped to retry/timeouts for streams. - Minor API aliasing added for TS to preserve existing helpers; Python/Go changes are additive. Performance/telemetry: Added telemetry hooks to surface "phasing events" and "stream state transitions". Benchmarks in the PR show a 2-7% reduction in observed p99 reconnect rate under a simulated rotation storm while maintaining median latency within 1% of baseline. Security/compatibility: No secrets stored differently; phasing only coordinates when token is swapped not how it's fetched. QA notes: Added stress tests that simulate overlapping rotations and high-concurrency stream churn. All stress tests are checked into python/tests/stress_phasing.py and equivalent harnesses in TS/Go. Rollout plan: - Canary the Python SDK in internal dogfood services for 2 weeks with logging level set to debug for phasing events. - After stable behavior, flip on TS and Go canaries. - Recommend opt-in for public customers initially, then consider enabling by default if no regressions. Related tickets and PRs: ENG-2150 (investigate stream reconnect storms), ENG-2187 (cross-sdk parity test harness). Merge outcome: squash-merged into main on 2026-01-28 after approvals from all reviewers. Notes: kept change surface intentionally small in the public API; most of the work is internal phasing orchestration and improved tests/examples.
